_NOTE: Dedicated PSR config for TC-05 RCS verification test. Uses proper FAA ASR-11 reference geometry: 111 km reference range, 0 dBsm reference RCS, matching rangeLimits. This exposes the R^4 dependence so a 30 dB RCS gap (20 dBsm airliner vs -10 dBsm stealth) produces a measurable detection ratio at 100 km range. The default_PSR.json uses a shorter 20 km range limit which is more appropriate for close-in demo scenarios but masks RCS differences via SNR saturation.
name: Primary Search Radar (TC-05 long-range)
